label: Ninh Binh
short_description: Limestone-karst scenery around Trang An and Tam Coc, often called Ha Long Bay on land, roughly two hours south of Hanoi.
intro: Ninh Binh's hotel coverage in this directory covers the limestone-karst region south of Hanoi built around the Trang An Landscape Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the boat-canal scenery of Tam Coc -- sometimes described as an inland Ha Long Bay. It sits roughly 90-100km, or about a two-hour drive, from Hanoi and Noi Bai International Airport, and also anchors the ancient Hoa Lu capital and Cuc Phuong National Park nearby. Until 2026 the area had no internationally branded hotels, so this is a genuinely new market for the directory, and views over the karst landscape or rice paddies are the main differentiator between properties.
